description: Send a text message from one of your paired Android phones, using that phone's own number and carrier plan, to a real person. Confirm the recipient and wording with the user before sending. The call returns once the message is queued and pushed to the phone, not when it is delivered: use get_message_status with the returned message_id to follow it. Pass scheduled_at to send it later instead of now. Free plans have a daily sending limit.

device_id.description: Optional id of the phone to send from (see list_devices). If omitted, the first online phone is used. If none is online, it is queued for the first paired phone and fails if that phone does not come back within 24 hours.

media_url.description: Optional public URL of an image to attach. Makes this a picture message (MMS).

message.description: The text to send, up to 1600 characters.

phone.description: The recipient's phone number. Use E.164 format (e.g. +15551234567). A number without a country code is read in the country of the phone's SIM. Several numbers separated by commas (up to 25) send one group message.

scheduled_at.description: Optional time to send it instead of now, as an ISO 8601 timestamp with a time zone (e.g. 2026-11-03T14:30:00Z or 2026-11-03T09:30:00-05:00). Must be in the future. The server releases it to the phone at that time. Use list_scheduled_messages to see what is pending and cancel_scheduled_message to call one off.

sim_slot.description: Optional, dual-SIM phones only: which SIM to send from, 0 for SIM 1 and 1 for SIM 2. If omitted, the phone uses the SIM chosen for that conversation, else the SIM the recipient last texted, else its default.

name: send_message
title: Send a text
